verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an infrastructure automation tool, but the evidence documents no event-driven triggers. Policy enforcement only validates plans against rules during runs; it does not fire actions on events. `-auto-approve` merely skips confirmation for a one-off apply, and neither amounts to a recurring or event-based trigger.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
